verdicts.reason: MINOR_UNITS has JPY with 0 and KWD with 3 decimals, so not every supported currency has two.
list_page is capped by max_page_size (100), so a huge limit does not return every record; the count would stop at 100.
CouponBook uppercases codes on add and strips and uppercases on get; it does not key by the code as passed.
replace() is a shallow copy: the copy shares the rates dict, so t.rates[region] = percent also changes the original table.
Quote.tax is one tax on the discounted taxable base, not a sum of per-line taxes; per-line rounding can differ.
